status: registered after v1 FAILED and before any v2 result was computed. What was seen first is disclosed below.
v1_outcome: jev-plans-search-v1 failed selection: no configuration reached t >= 2.77 on BTC/ETH/SOL over the dev period. Its best, momentum(N=180,k=1), was carried to validation labelled failed and was not confirmed (t 1.48 dev assets, 2.26 holdout assets; most of it shorts, in a period where 14 of 15 assets fell 20-63%).
already_seen: all 18 v1 configurations on BTC/ETH/SOL over the dev period; momentum(N=180,k=1) on every asset in every period. Nothing else.

what_changes_and_why.assets: selection uses ALL 15 assets over the dev period, confirmation ALL 15 over the validation period (a time split only). v1 selected on 3 assets, too few trades for lumpy trend trades to reach significance even if the effect were real.
what_changes_and_why.unit: each trade is scored in R = net bp / the bp distance from fill to initial stop, the trend-following convention, so a volatile coin's trade counts the same in risk units as BTC's. v1 summed bp and the wildest coins dominated.
what_changes_and_why.clustering: crypto assets move together, so trades on 15 assets in the same week are not independent. The statistic is a t over CALENDAR WEEKS: each week's value is the sum of R of every trade exiting that week (weeks with no exit count as 0 from the first to the last exit of the period).
what_changes_and_why.beta: a strategy that is only long in a rising market or only short in a falling one is beta. To be confirmed, a configuration's longs and shorts must EACH have mean R >= 0 over dev+validation combined (2024-06 to 2026-10 holds both a bull run and a bear market).

unchanged_from_v1: the 18-configuration grid, the families, the costs, the 3000-bar split, the 200-bar warmup, one plan at a time per asset
selection: net R > 0 and weekly t >= 2.77 over the dev period (Bonferroni, 18 trials)
confirmation: each survivor: net R > 0 and weekly t >= 1.645 / Bonferroni over survivors on the validation period, AND the beta rule
if_none: if nothing survives, the best by dev weekly t is carried to validation labelled as failed, and the search is reported as failed. No v3 is run on this data.
no_amendment: nothing above changes after results are seen
